info.title: CoCIS Smart Control & Monitoring API
info.description:
Database API for the ESP32 access-control, occupancy and lighting system
(Embedded Systems coursework, Makerere University, 2026/2027).

## How to test it here

1. Click **Authorize** (top right, padlock icon).
2. Under **AdminLogin** enter username `admin` and password `Admin@CoCIS2026`
   (leave client_id and client_secret empty) and click **Authorize**.
3. Under **DeviceKey** enter `esp32-demo-key-change-me` and click **Authorize**. Close the dialog.
4. Open any endpoint, click **Try it out**, then **Execute**. The example bodies are ready to send.

A good first run: `POST /api/v1/device/access/check` (Lisa Nyonyozi scans in),
then `GET /api/v1/occupancy` (she is listed as inside).
Change `event_uuid` before sending a scan again: a repeated `event_uuid` is treated as a
duplicate upload and returns the first answer with `"duplicate": true`.

## Demo data

| What | Value |
|------|-------|
| Admin login (SUPER_ADMIN) | `admin` / `Admin@CoCIS2026` |
| ESP32 device key | `esp32-demo-key-change-me` |
| RFID tags | `A1B2C3D4` student, `11223344` lecturer, `DEADBEEF` security, `CAFEBABE` visitor |
| Opening hours | Mon to Fri 07:00 to 22:00, Sat 08:00 to 17:00, Sun closed |

Scans outside the opening hours are refused with `OUTSIDE_SCHEDULE`, so keep `occurred_at` on a weekday at 09:00.

post.description:
Online path: the ESP32 sends a scan, the server decides, records it and
answers in one transaction. The ESP32 opens the door only on GRANTED.
A person crossed a lecture-room doorway (IR beams), or the lights changed.

Offline path: records queued on the SD card while Wi-Fi was down.
The decision was already made by the ESP32, so we store it as-is.
Duplicate event_uuids are skipped, so re-sending a batch is always safe.

get.description: Everything the ESP32 caches on its SD card to decide offline.

post.description: Periodic 'I am alive'. Reply tells the ESP32 whether to re-download config.

Log in with a JSON body and receive a bearer token (used by Postman and the firmware).
The example body is the demo account, so **Try it out** then **Execute** works as it is.

Form login used by the **Authorize** button in Swagger UI. Enter
`admin` / `Admin@CoCIS2026` there and every locked endpoint is then sent with the token.

delete.description: Soft delete: the tag stops working but history is kept for the records.

put.description:
Manual override, e.g. force LR1 lights off during a power-saving period.
AUTO returns control to the IR beam occupancy counter. The ESP32 picks this up on its next config pull.
Fire / evacuation: unlock every door regardless of schedule.
